html:
Wasp Towers exist in Rookgaard (here (32000, 32139, 7)), and on multiple locations around Darashia (here (33210, 32385, 7), here (33124, 32453, 7), here (33104, 32347, 7), here (33201, 32311, 7) and here (33308, 32342, 7)). These towers are a great source of Honeycombs.


Rookgaard wasp tower

Ground level: 1 wasp
+1: 2 wasps
+2: 3 wasps
+3: 4 wasps
+4: 5 wasps

The +4 level contains a honey flower patch, search it and you'll obtain a Honey flower, used for the Studded Legs Quest

Darashia wasp towers

Main wasp tower (closest to town)

Ground Level: None
+1: 10 wasps
Note: Theres 4 ladders to go up any further

+2, NE ladder: 2 wasps
+3, NE ladder: 2 wasps

+2, NW ladder: 2 wasps
+3, NW ladder: 2 wasps

+2, SE ladder: 1 wasp
+3, SE ladder: 2 wasps

+2, SW ladder: 2 wasps
+3, SW ladder: 3 wasps

North wasp tower

Ground Level: 4 wasps
+1: 3 wasps
+2: 3 wasps
